confirmed: the fact states a two-route law — an out-of-alphabet separator, or a grammatical guarantee on one half — and BOTH routes are observably in force in this repository at once. Route one: `spec://` and pkgref join with `/`, a character in neither declared alphabet, and PROP-029 `##CARRIER-BYTE-IDENTITY` (25) records the payoff. Route two: the flat repo-name carrier joins with `.` and is split back deterministically, because PROP-008 `##JOINER-UNDERSCORE` (114) guarantees the name is a single dot-free LDH label and names the function that enforces it. The fact's refinement over the worker's draft — that the guaranteed half decides whether the FIRST or the LAST occurrence is the boundary — is what makes the law general rather than an accident of which half vibevm happens to constrain; vibevm constrains the second half, hence the last dot.
